name: Staff of Illumination
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 197, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 494
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 197, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 494
Aura strong evocation CL 15th
Slot none; Price 51,500 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This staff is usually sheathed in a layer of silver and decorated with gold and amber sunbursts. A staff of illumination allows use of the following spells:
Dancing lights (1 charge)
Flare (1 charge)
Daylight (2 charges)
Sunburst (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, dancing lights, daylight, flare, sunburst; Cost 25,750 gp
